tickets.text: Add to would_change (seow, position system, R15/C14/C29): a daily close below the support line max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), or a red-candle proxy (elder_pattern leaving SUSTAINED/ACCELERATION, or bar_close < bar_open after the up-run) then a trade under that bar's low next session. The stop is fixed by the chart, never a percentage of entry (C8), so I do not read 'entry-8pct' as my exit.
